title: Hike to "La Pedriza"
description:
This 16km hike with 305m elevation will take us through breathtaking trails and stunning views. The perfect way to escape the city, breathe fresh mountain air, and enjoy the beauty of Madrid’s Sierra. 🌄🌲🍂

Lace up your boots, pack your layers, and get ready for a day of nature, adventure, and great company! 💪🥾🎒

This is the perfect opportunity to connect with nature, make new international friends, and discover a totally different side of Madrid — just a short trip away from the city. Whether you’re a hiking pro or just looking for a fun outdoor adventure, this experience is for you

Be prepared (boot's wise please)!!



📍 Where [Meeting Point]: Intercambiador de Plaza Castilla

🕘 When: 6 September 2026, 8:00 AM

🚌 How: We’ll take the bus from Plaza Castilla to Manzanares together, bus number 724

⛰️ Difficulty: Easy

🕒 Duration: Approx. 6-7 hours (including breaks and lunch)
